HockeyAllsvenskan Standings

Source: R/ha.R
ha_standings.Rd

Standings of a season. Wins and losses are REGULATION only; overtime counts include shootouts.

Wins and losses are REGULATION only (regulation_wins / regulation_losses) and the overtime counts include shootouts (overtime_and_shootout_wins / _losses); the team table's wins_total / losses_total of ha_team_stats() are totals including overtime and shootout results, so do not mix them. team_code is the display code; the upstream teamCode mixes the StatNet id (MODO) and the display code (MORA) and is kept only as team_code_mixed. power_play_perc / penalty_kill_perc arrive as "" (NA).

Usage

ha_standings(
  season = NULL,
  phase = "HA",
  location = "all",
  return_parsed = TRUE
)

Arguments

season

Season END year (2026 = 2025/26); the site's START-year key is sent as season - 1. NULL = the season in progress. Stats and standings start in 2005/06 (2006).

phase

Game type: HA regular season, HAPlayoff playoffs, HAkval playout (relegation series). Allowed: HA, HAPlayoff, HAkval.

location

Home / away standings split. Allowed: all, home, away.

return_parsed

Parse the payload into a tibble (default TRUE). Pass FALSE for the raw JSON as a list (stamped with the request under _request where the body does not say what it answers).

Value

A tibble (return_parsed = TRUE), else the raw JSON list:

col_nametypedescription
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025/26).
rankintegerRank in the table.
team_code_mixedcharacterUpstream standings teamCode: the StatNet id for some clubs (MODO), the display code for others (MORA, NVIF, ÖIK). Join on team_code instead.
team_codecharacterDisplay code of the team (AIK, MoDo, MORA, NVIF, ÖIK), not the StatNet id.
games_playedintegerGames played in the season and phase.
regulation_winsintegerRegulation wins only (the team table's wins_total also counts OT and shootout wins).
regulation_lossesintegerRegulation losses only.
tiesintegerTies (0 in the overtime era).
overtime_and_shootout_winsintegerOvertime wins, shootout wins included.
overtime_and_shootout_lossesintegerOvertime losses, shootout losses included.
shootouts_winsintegerShootout wins as sent (0 in every sampled row: they are counted in overtime_and_shootout_wins).
shootouts_lossesintegerShootout losses as sent (0 in every sampled row).
goalsintegerGoals scored by the team (goals for).
goals_againstintegerGoals conceded by the team.
goal_differenceintegerGoal difference.
total_pointsintegerStandings points of the team.
power_play_percnumericPower-play percentage; empty-string placeholder ” in every sample.
penalty_kill_percnumericPenalty-kill percentage; empty-string placeholder ” in every sample.

Errors

fastRhockey_no_data: the site has nothing for the request (a season before 2005/06, an unknown or pre-2025/26 game, a phase not played, a body without rows). fastRhockey_bad_request: a value outside its enumerated set, a field the site requires is missing, or HTTP 400/422. fastRhockey_asset_fetch: any other non-2xx, a connection failure after retries, or an empty, non-JSON, error-shaped, truncated or out-of-scope 200 (the answer is unknown, not empty).

See also

Other HA Functions: ha_game(), ha_games(), ha_goalie_stats(), ha_leaders(), ha_pbp(), ha_players(), ha_schedule(), ha_skater_stats(), ha_team_stats(), ha_teams()
